## About Liebherr

More than 50,000 employees help to shape technological progress in many industries. The Group is
managed to this day by the Liebherr family.

## Liebherr worldwide

Liebherr started to focus on international business and establish companies outside Germany at the
end of the 1950s. The Liebherr Group now comprises over 150 companies in more than 50 countries on
every continent.

[View all locations][47]

## Services

Aside from high quality products, Liebherr offers its customers tailored solutions according to
their respective needs. Whether spare parts orders, production licenses or telemetry systems –
Liebherr stands for comprehensive service and competent advice.

[View all services][48]

## History

By inventing the tower crane In 1949, Hans Liebherr lays the foundations for the success of the
Liebherr Group.

It is a convenient platform where you can quickly, efficiently, and safely buy or sell special
machinery, as more than 1,400,000 users from 80 countries browse our pages every day in search of
the right product.
Security

We take great care to ensure that the portal is safe for both buyers and sellers. We have solid
experience in this area and invest a lot of time and resources in security.

The design of the website has been developed to make the search process as comfortable as possible:
many filters, the ability to compare and sort, add to favourites, and read reviews of the seller.

### Heavy Plant by Millar Tractors Ltd.

Millar Tractors is a family run business formed in 1996 in response to the increasing demand for
Japanese construction equipment, we are now firmly established as one of the leading, privately
owned, plant and construction machinery sales companies in the United Kingdom.

We specialise in the importing and exporting of all types of construction machinery worldwide. In
the early days, we focused on bringing new and used plant from Japan to satisfy the huge demand in
the Irish market. However, in recent years due to the down turn in Europe we have been focusing on
export markets and have sold machines as far as Hong Kong, Thailand, America and Australia!

## About Liebherr

More than 50,000 employees help to shape technological progress in many industries. The Group is
managed to this day by the Liebherr family.

## Liebherr worldwide

Liebherr started to focus on international business and establish companies outside Germany at the
end of the 1950s. The Liebherr Group now comprises over 150 companies in more than 50 countries on
every continent.

[View all locations][47]

## Services

Aside from high quality products, Liebherr offers its customers tailored solutions according to
their respective needs. Whether spare parts orders, production licenses or telemetry systems –
Liebherr stands for comprehensive service and competent advice.

[View all services][48]

## History

By inventing the tower crane In 1949, Hans Liebherr lays the foundations for the success of the
Liebherr Group.

## CP Machinery, Power Global Farming

Quality Tractors Trusted Worldwide

**Weifang CP Machinery Co., Ltd. is a professional agricultural machinery manufacturer integrating
R&D, **production and export, based in Weifang, the hometown of tractors in Shandong Province,
China. Our product portfolio covers full-range tractors: mini tractor, medium tractor, large wheel
tractor, crawler tractor, garden tractor and E-mark certified tractors for European road legal use,
plus supporting farming implements for ploughing, seeding and harvesting. We equip two professional
tractor assembly lines, with stable annual production capacity of 12,000 complete sets of tractors
and matching farm tools. Strict quality inspection runs through every production procedure, all
EU-sold tractors pass E-mark certification to meet local road and emission standards. Up to now, our
tractors and implements have been exported to more than 80 countries, covering Southeast Asia, South
Asia, Central Asia, Europe, Africa and South America, including Poland, Ukraine, Russia, Thailand,
Vietnam, Nigeria, Brazil and Kazakhstan. We stick to factory direct supply, competitive price,
flexible MOQ, fast delivery and all-round after-sales support, striving to be your reliable one-stop
farm machinery partner worldwide.
